games.name: infinite minesweeper
games.desc:
source code is hosted at cozywitchcraft/infinite-minesweeper
thanks for playing

how to play:
* step on closed tiles to open them
* number shows how many mines surround that tile
* click or tap to mark tiles as mines
* open as many tiles as you can!

commands:
/votekick <player>: initiates a votekick
/kick <player>: kicks a player (admin-only)
/ban <player>: bans a player from the server (admin-only)
/announce <message>: displays a server-wide message (admin-only)
/restart: restarts the current round (admin-only)
/respawn: respawns character
/rejoin: rejoins the server

inspired by bLockerman's minesweeper and 1000mines
premium users get free subspace tripmine

games.name: Thy hood
games.desc:
in 1800s great britain, an old, poverty-stricken town sits in a state of disarray, packed with unholy beings, polluted water, underground dungeons, strange guns and tea. it is named forwesterchestershire and the locals are very strange people

the rich run the streets, capricious and unscrupulous; it is your goal to become one of them through any means necessary.

beg for money! scavenge for farthings! clean the chimneys! fish for leeches! dig for truffles! mine for ore! shank the unassuming! heal the ill! commit theft! uphold the law! kill monsters! run the town with a huge target on your head! explore the dungeons! spread diseases! snipe someone's auction! do obscure side quests!

this town is your oyster and its pearls are to be plundered. it is your neighborhood. it is THY HOOD.

whats new:
bug fixes, dungeon fixes, raid fixes, boss QOL improvements, economy improvements, weapon re-balancing
more in the server
